scope: Final read-only visual inspection of every page in a copied snapshot of the 20-page paper PDF.

pages.notes: Title, abstract, exact community-request Lean excerpt, and section transition are legible.
Development account, mathematical definitions, theorem, and equations are legible.
Figure 1 is inside Library evaluation after its introduction; both panels, marks, axes, and full caption are legible.
Related work and scope are legible and main content remains within four pages.
Bibliography URLs wrap without clipping.
Proof appendix has intact notation and margins.
Proof continuation and theorem proof are legible.
Community-source provenance, averaging, and quantified examples are legible.
Metric, reverse-triangle, boundary, and source-example material is legible; source block continues onto page 10.
Continued source block and replacements remain readable; evaluation appendix begins cleanly.
Implementation and census methods are legible and precede their tables.
Tables 1 and 2 are readable; the 310-row label now explicitly says lines saved.
Tables 3 through 6 are legible with distinct captions and no clipping.
Table 7 is legible but alone on a mostly empty float page.
Timing method is continuous and no longer interrupted by census tables; calibration table is legible.
Per-file timing table begins with intact path wrapping and numeric columns.
Timing continuation and new AI provenance account are legible.
AI regression and acceptance account and reproducibility section are readable.
Implementation guide and certificate/search excerpts are legible with correct line numbering.
Search continuation and proof-construction excerpt are legible with no clipping.

findings.description: The two-row implementation-cost Table 7 occupies an otherwise empty float page. It is readable and does not obscure any content, but wastes an appendix page.
findings.recommendation: If making a layout-only pass, keep this small table with nearby census content or the start of timing methods while retaining the census/timing separation.

confirmed_revisions: The exact motivating inequality is printed as a readable checked-source excerpt on page 1.
The figure is placed within the evaluation section on page 3.
The caption defines each file point using mean times across 40 paired passes.
The savings label unambiguously identifies 310 as lines saved.
Census tables no longer interrupt the timing explanation.
The expanded AI-development account includes concrete recorded steps and a correction example.
release_note: Compare the release PDF hash with pdf_sha256. If rebuilding changes the bytes, render and compare images; re-inspect any changed pages before transferring this review to the final artifact.
